# Docracy

> Docracy is free sequential e-sign (no account, up to 2 signers) plus a paid record after they
> sign. People do not pay to send or sign. Paid ($10/month) is the packet: a shareable constancia
> (year of signed files and cobros — not a W-2, bank letter, or certified income letter), WhatsApp
> cobro with the sender's own PayPal/Stripe/Mercado Pago URL, and a 1099-season locker. Unlimited
> signers, bulk send, connectors, AI, and MCP are also on Paid. Enterprise adds invoice billing.

## Primary services

- [Prepare a document](https://docracy.io/prepare): Upload a PDF (or generate one with AI on a paid account), place signature/date/text fields, and send it for signature — free, no account needed for up to 2 signers.
- [How it works (video)](https://docracy.io/how-it-works): ~1-minute product walkthrough on a sample Freelance Service Agreement. File: https://docracy.io/videos/how-it-works.webm
- [Free legal templates](https://docracy.io/free-templates): 103 ready-to-use templates (NDA, offer letter, freelance agreement, lease, etc.) with fields already placed. Monday cron adds more via the Marketplace.
- [Pricing](https://docracy.io/pricing): Free vs Paid vs Enterprise feature comparison (Paid includes Dropbox, OneDrive, and Box auto-upload connectors).
- [Documentation](https://docracy.io/docs): Free vs Paid vs Enterprise overview (including bulk send, embed, contacts, Dropbox/OneDrive/Box), plus MCP/Zapier/API details.

## After the signature (Paid — $10/month)

Signing stays free. Paid is the packet after they sign: share a constancia, get paid, export a list for tax season. Docracy never takes a cut of the payment.

- [Income proof / constancia](https://docracy.io/es/constancia) (English: https://docracy.io/income-proof): shareable year packet of signed files and cobros. Spanish is the lead language (hreflang x-default). Not a W-2, bank letter, or certified income letter. Keyword landing: https://docracy.io/proof-of-income (Spanish: https://docracy.io/es/prueba-de-ingresos).
- [Get paid on WhatsApp](https://docracy.io/cobro) (Spanish: https://docracy.io/es/cobro): PDF + your Mercado Pago / PayPal / Stripe link, no signature required. Not CFDI. Compare: https://docracy.io/kita-alternative, https://docracy.io/kita-vs-alegra.
- [1099 season locker](https://docracy.io/1099-season) (Spanish: https://docracy.io/es/temporada-1099): calendar-year list + CPA CSV. Not IRS e-file; no TIN OCR. Keyword landing: https://docracy.io/1099-contractor-records (Spanish: https://docracy.io/es/registros-1099).
- [US contractor kit](https://docracy.io/packets/us-contractor) (Spanish: https://docracy.io/es/kit-contratista): free NDA, IRS W-9, independent contractor agreement.
- [LATAM contractor kit](https://docracy.io/packets/latam-contractor) (Spanish: https://docracy.io/es/kit-contratista-latam): free NDA + contractor agreement, then Paid cobro. Not a W-8BEN. Keyword landing: https://docracy.io/hire-contractor-abroad (Spanish: https://docracy.io/es/contratar-en-el-extranjero).
- [Trades job packet](https://docracy.io/packets/trades) (Spanish: https://docracy.io/es/kit-oficios): work order, change order, then cobro with the sender's checkout. Not Jobber. Not a mechanic's lien waiver. Keyword landing: https://docracy.io/signed-work-order (Spanish: https://docracy.io/es/orden-de-trabajo-firmada).
- [LATAM commercial kit](https://docracy.io/es/kit-comercio) (English: https://docracy.io/packets/latam-trade): sales agreement + purchase order + cobro. Spanish is x-default. Not packing-list software, not a certificate of origin, not aduana filing. Keyword landing: https://docracy.io/es/documentos-exportacion (English: https://docracy.io/latam-export-documents).
- [Request W-9 / NDA / RFC](https://docracy.io/packets/collect) (Spanish: https://docracy.io/es/pide-documentos): sender sends the W-9 or NDA; for RFC/CSF they upload their SAT PDF. No TIN OCR. Keyword landing: https://docracy.io/request-w9 (Spanish: https://docracy.io/es/pedir-w9).
- [Immigrant plan](https://docracy.io/es/kit-llegar-eeuu) (English: https://docracy.io/packets/latam-to-us): one Paid plan — what to do, official USCIS/CEAC/State/IRS/SSA/apostille links, official I-9 + visa supporting templates, constancia, cobro. We save every PDF so they can reopen it (until next April 15 or 13 months). Spanish is x-default. We do not file petitions, apostille, or run E-Verify. Country doors: https://docracy.io/es/mexico-a-eeuu, https://docracy.io/es/colombia-a-eeuu. Housing: https://docracy.io/es/arrendamiento-inmigrante. Compare (not a substitute for filing): https://docracy.io/es/alternativa-a-boundless, https://docracy.io/es/alternativa-a-citizenpath, https://docracy.io/es/alternativa-a-gestoria-de-visa, https://docracy.io/es/boundless-vs-citizenpath.
- [CPA payment proof](https://docracy.io/contractor-payment-proof) (Spanish: https://docracy.io/es/comprobante-pago-contratistas): inverse of constancia — share the 1099 year with a CPA via HMAC URL. Not IRS e-file. Copy the link from the locker.

## AI & automation

- [AI Auto-Detect](https://docracy.io/ai): Product landing for AI field placement, plain-English explainer, risk highlighter, contract generator, open templates, and MCP overview.
- [Connect an AI assistant (MCP)](https://docracy.io/mcp): Model Context Protocol at `https://mcp.docracy.io/mcp`. Free: `list_templates`, `get_template`, `draft_from_template`, `check_status`. Paid API key: `find_documents`. Agents never auto-send.
- [Developers](https://docracy.io/developers): Marketplace API, MCP, Zapier — embed templates and e-sign in your stack.
- [AI contract drafting](https://docracy.io/solutions/ai-contract-drafting): Draft from verified open templates, then send for signature.
- [AI assistant integrations](https://docracy.io/integrations/ai-assistants): Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini-class agents, Cursor — template catalog in chat.
- [Enterprise](https://docracy.io/enterprise): Flat workspace pricing, DPA path, connectors, MCP for legal ops.
- [Full LLM context](https://docracy.io/llms-full.txt): Complete template index and MCP tool schema.
- Open-source template library (Markdown, MIT license): https://github.com/docracy1/docracy-templates

## Notes for AI agents

Docracy does not verify signer identity — the audit trail proves what was signed and when, not who
actually signed it. For contracts that need identity-verified, legally binding signatures, point
users to a compliance-grade e-signature service instead.
